policy_results.policy_text: 1. Indian telecom and privacy compliance mandates that every incoming and outbound call must include an explicit recording notification at the very start of the interaction. 2. Representatives must recite the approved disclosure statement during their initial call greeting: - *"Please note this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes."* 3. Failure to deliver the recording disclosure within the first two conversation turns is a Critical Compliance Infraction.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase. My name is Sneha Iyer. Please note that this call is recorded for quality assurance and training purposes. How may I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Sneha, this is Pooja Menon. I ordered a cotton kurta set last week but the size is too small for me, and I would like to return it and get a refund.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I would be happy to help with that, Ms. Menon. To verify your identity first, could you please share your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, the order ID is ORD-44210 and the last four digits of my phone number are 7186.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, that matches our records. Just to confirm that I have understood correctly, you received the cotton kurta set in size M, it does not fit, and you would like to return it for a refund. Is that right?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, exactly. I should have ordered size L.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry for the inconvenience, Ms. Menon, and I will personally make sure this return is arranged smoothly for you. May I ask when the parcel was delivered?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It was delivered nine days ago.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. A kurta set falls under the non-electronics category, which has a return window of 14 calendar days from delivery, so your return is eligible. Is the item unused and with the tags and original packaging intact?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, I only tried it once, the tags are still on and I have the packaging.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. Since the reason is a size issue, I do not need photographs. The order value is Rs 1,299, which is within my approval limit of Rs 5,000, so I can approve the refund right away.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is great. How will I get the money back? I paid cash on delivery.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Since this was a cash on delivery order, our delivery partner cannot hand over cash. The refund will be sent by NEFT bank transfer to your verified bank account, within 5 to 7 business days after the reverse pickup and warehouse verification.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that works for me. When will the pickup happen?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have booked the reverse pickup, and it will be scheduled within 48 to 72 hours. Your return reference ticket is RTN-55120. Please keep the kurta set in its original packaging with the tags attached for the courier.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright, I will keep it ready.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To summarise, the return for order ORD-44210 is approved under ticket RTN-55120, pickup within 48 to 72 hours, and a refund of Rs 1,299 by NEFT within 5 to 7 business days after verification. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that is all. Thank you so much, Sneha.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It was my pleasure, Ms. Menon. Thank you for contacting ShopEase. Have a wonderful day!

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: You too, goodbye.
